title: DIN DKE SPEC 99100 — Requirements for data attributes of the battery passport
usedFor: The attribute list that BatteryPass-Ready's longlist says it is built on. Gap input for the battery product group, behind the Commission's own guidance.
source: DIN and VDE press releases and trade coverage, and BatteryPass-Ready's v2.0 announcement, which names it as the basis of its longlist. The document has not been opened.
finding: Published in January 2025 under the title "Requirements for Data Attributes of the Battery Passport", as DIN DKE SPEC 99100:2025-02 in the edition the Battery Pass repository names. Press coverage says it can be downloaded free of charge from DIN Media. The terms of that download are not known, so `licence` stays null. It is a DIN and DKE specification, not a European standard, and it is not one of the six standards cited in Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1736.
nextStep: Read it alongside the BatteryPass-Ready v2.0 files (see `batterypass-ready`). Open the DIN Media page first and record the download terms; cite the document by clause and never quote it.
